annotations.title: Explain US airline ticket tax and fee codes

description: US airline ticket taxes and fees: explain two-character tax codes from a ticket receipt (for example US, ZP, AY, XF, YC, XY, XA), with each amount, its effective date and its source (detail 'full' adds every note). Codes not in the verified list are reported as such, never guessed. Fare basis codes are not covered. Input: only the tax codes and the optional detail level; names, confirmation codes, ticket numbers and frequent flyer numbers aren't needed or used.

codes.description: 1 to 20 two-character tax codes from the ticket's tax box.

detail.description: Optional. "brief" (default) gives the main facts; "full" adds every note we have.

name: explain_tax_codes
